name: Pocket Waifu: Rekindled
source: Imagine a world where you strike a pact with a Succubus, turning your life upside down. Overnight, you transform from a single to a babe magnet. The question remains: are you capable of satisfying them all? Discover the answer today!
translation: 想象这样一个世界：你与一只魅魔缔结了契约，生活自此天翻地覆。一夜之间，你从单身汉摇身一变成了令无数美女趋之若鹜的万人迷。唯一的问题只剩下：你的身体吃得消满足她们所有人吗？今天就来一探究竟吧！
